_README: Inline-provenance census + mechanical growth-stop (2026-08-28). TWO REGISTERS, TWO KINDS OF TRUTH. (1) `census`: the SEMANTIC map — every verified ad-hoc truth-state / numeric-confidence render site in client/src, produced by a 4-modality sweep (95 candidate sites, 59 files), per-file classification against what the user actually sees, and an adversarial refute pass (3 files refuted: honest-absence renders, query captions, domain outputs). It is the step-3 MIGRATION WORKLIST for docs/company/experience-legibility.md: migrate a file to DataProvenanceChip / DataConfidenceBadge, delete its entry in the same commit. The gate checks only that each census file still exists — the semantics were verified once by reading, and each migration re-verifies its file. (2) `mechanicalBaseline`: per-file counts of the SIGNAL /confiden(?!tial)/i on non-import, non-comment lines, all of client/src minus the two canonical primitives. This measures the WORD, not the defect — it exists so inline confidence UI CANNOT GROW while the census is worked down: any file above its count, or any new file with signal, fails; any file below its count must have its baseline lowered in the same commit. The 13 census files whose ad-hoc UI is purely 'source/as-of' prose have no signal — the census carries them; the mechanical half never claims to. MIGRATION WAVE 2026-08-28: 67 sites migrated by a 54-agent workflow (one agent per file, per-file adversarial verification, 6 files hand-verified after verifier deaths); the census worklist is now EMPTY and the `adjudicated` register holds the 24 sites deliberately KEPT with their reasons — statistical-significance pills (a domain metric neither primitive can honestly render), measured confidence-interval bands, query captions, map legend keys, marketing prose. An adjudicated site is a decided exception: re-litigating one is a product-identity change, and ADDING ad-hoc confidence UI anywhere is still stopped by mechanicalBaseline.
